study type: mixed method, online anonymous self-report survey
outcome: variability in delivery and content of communication training
inclusion of standalone child-centred communication modules
educator professional experience in delivering communication training
impact of curriculum capacity on communication training delivery
reliance on clinical practice for child specific communication training
cohort: The participants were 32 Programme Leads of undergraduate children's nursing programmes across the Republic of Ireland and the United Kingdom.
finding: The study found significant variability in the delivery and content of communication training across Higher Educational Institutions, generally lacking a specific focus on children and young people and not always supported by educators with relevant professional experience.
cross-section timing: The study captured communication curriculum reported as currently being delivered within undergraduate children's nursing programmes at the time of the survey (around 2024).
